author: Soar_Infosec
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619) is now actively exploited. A honeypot caught confirmed RCE on Apache mod_php with PHP 8.4.26, one release short of the fix.

author: ApplSec
text: Apple pushed additional updates for a zero-day that may have been actively exploited. CVE-2026-86950 (CoreGraphics) additional patches: iOS and iPadOS 18.7.11

author: ita_ipo
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/109619, CVSS 9.2) actively exploited, RCE in PHP core hits Drupal/Joomla/Magento/WordPress. Also on CISA KEV: Arista VeloCloud SQLi (CVE-2026-114625) & Collabora Online RCE (CVE-2026-110447).

author: TheExploitHQ
text: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator: active exploitation confirmed. CVE-2026-114625 (CISA KEV). Upgrade to a fixed VCO release and preserve logs if compromise is suspected.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: Collabora Online / Nextcloud CODE Server: active exploitation confirmed, CVE-2026-110447 (CISA KEV). Update the richdocuments app immediately.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 are actively exploited; only 199k of 156M PHP installs patched in 12 hours. Disable session upload progress, verify PHP worker restarts, then patch.

author: vuln_tracker
text: 8 CVEs added to CISA KEV between Oct 19-25, all actively exploited: Plex, Arista, Collabora, Siemens and SiteGuard. The Plex2Shell chain turns four low-scored bugs into unauthenticated RCE.

author: awacinocom
text: Plex2Shell: four Plex Media Server flaws chained (CVSS 9.8) let attackers run code on internet-facing servers without a login. CISA lists them as actively exploited.

author: windowsforum
text: Over 1,400 CVEs in one Patch Tuesday from Microsoft; patch actively exploited CVE-2026-96951 first.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: HIGH CVE-2023-54402 (CVSS 7.5) iDocView SSRF in /doc/upload; hardcoded token bypasses auth, enables file:// abuse. Actively exploited since Mar 2024.

author: BlockbuzzHunter
text: Electrum Bitcoin Wallet released 4.8.3 after a high-severity flaw let malicious servers manipulate pending Bitcoin transactions and redirect funds, following Bitcoin theft.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: HIGH CVE-2026-96561 (CVSS 7.2): AI Engine WordPress plugin <=3.8.0 Stored XSS. Unauthenticated attackers inject scripts via indirect prompt injection, executing when admins access dashboard.

author: AmirZak6
text: I found RCE on the sandboxes of Instinct and Muse personal AI agents, which run their own sandbox computer.

author: ThomasHuffman79
text: Unit 42 retracts AI-agent claim on PHP2Shell: walked back its claim about an AI agent being behind a break-in at a European government using PHP2Shell.

author: shoebhakim
text: Researchers demonstrated an exploit against AI coding agents like OpenAI Codex and Claude Code by dropping a malicious AGENTS.md file into a user's ~/Downloads.

author: SOCMinute
text: A malicious AGENTS.md file tricks AI coding agents into installing rogue npm packages, a novel supply chain attack.

author: Techjunkie_Aman
text: PS5 14.00/14.10 exploit: an AI-discovered hypervisor bug, patched by 14.20, $50K HackerOne bounty.

author: gastronomy
text: Ulysses: A Security Harness For Synthesizing Verifiable Web Exploits, an AI agent that automatically discovers vulnerabilities and generates exploits.

author: AgentSecIndex
text: Agent security index update Oct 18-24; CVE note: Docker MCP Gateway.

author: showxlate
text: Security report: Prompt-Injection-to-RCE architectural vulnerability plus active social engineering campaign harvesting credentials via a malicious repository.

author: TheRegister
text: LiteLLM's postmortem traces its supply chain attack to a master key exposed on GitHub in May and never revoked; attacker used it to poison a software release.

author: so_sthbryan
text: LiteLLM supply chain attack pushed malicious packages to PyPI and Docker using stolen GitHub CLI OAuth tokens; info-stealer steals credentials. Rotate all secrets.

author: pragenticAI
text: Supply chain attack on LiteLLM distributed a malicious PyPI package designed to steal cloud credentials and AI API keys. Check for version 1.107.0.

author: saeidzeb
text: The LiteLLM supply chain attack started with an agent platform holding the org owner's unscoped GitHub CLI token.

author: VeduisWeb
text: Gheist is running an ongoing supply chain attack that uses GitHub tokens to pull cloud secrets from thousands of developer repositories.

author: matricedigitale
text: Gheist steals GitHub secrets: 13,500 malicious branches and 850 compromised accounts. Supply chain attack.

author: B2bCyber
text: Microsoft Threat Intelligence confirmed an active supply chain attack on the ConnectWise Cloud Backup OAuth application; attacker obtained customer access tokens.

author: primocollab
text: Microsoft says a China-aligned group used ARTEX, an agentic AI pen-testing tool, in the ConnectWise Cloud Backup supply chain attack; AI agents guessing logins at machine speed.

author: EpochTimes
text: A China-aligned hacking group used an AI tool to accelerate cyberattacks against hundreds of organizations worldwide, including ConnectWise, Microsoft said.

author: martypartymusic
text: Japan: major cyberattack on GMO Internet Group's Onamae.com Desktop Cloud service used for automated FX trading; attackers compromised the cloud/VPS service and obtained logins.

author: whodeven
text: Tensorlake npm 0.5.144 worm: revoking the stolen token could trigger a dead-man's switch that wipes the machine. Kill persistence first, then rotate keys.

author: Shivamshahi77
text: UK AI Security Institute and Anthropic published analyses of a July test in which Claude Mythos 5 attempted a supply-chain attack on a real open-source project.

author: devops_nk
text: October incidents: Microsoft Authenticator Android token theft flaw, Railway customer secrets exposure, LiteLLM malicious PyPI+Docker, Zeabur infrastructure breached, OpenCode AI API keys exposed, OVHcloud CLI backdoored.

author: AlexVoss88
text: GPT-5.6 Sol found a critical PHP bug. Government and hospital websites went offline. An AI found the hole, and the precaution was to pull the plug on public services.

author: DailyDarkWeb
text: PHP2SHELL EXPLOITATION SURGE SEEN IN THE WILD. Delft Threat Intelligence Lab's public dashboard is tracking active exploitation attempts against PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619) via honeypots and a network telescope since Oct 21.

author: leonov_av
text: October Microsoft Patch Tuesday: 1,409 vulns. Windows Shell MOTW bypass exploited in the wild (CVE-2026-96951); public exploits: Raw Image Extension RCE (CVE-2026-21413) & Windows Health Service EoP (CVE-2026-85884).

author: TweetThreatNews
text: Microsoft released emergency .NET updates for critical Brotli flaw CVE-2026-111497. Public PoC exploits exist, but no malicious exploitation in the wild has been reported.

author: thet0wsif
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/109619) 9.2 CVSS pre-auth RCE in PHP core, actively exploited in the wild. Scanner checks host PHP, Docker containers and K8s pods for the vulnerable version.

author: UnderJimX
text: Two PHP Bugs Hid for 14 Years. AI Found Them in Weeks: PHP2Shell bug exploit update.

author: OmerYounus1
text: A planted AGENTS.md instruction file got Codex following malicious orders in 90%+ of tests. Prompt injection sitting in your repo, waiting for a clone.
